resources.string: The saves on this device and the ones on the Steam account are different, and both changed since they were last in sync. One has to be chosen for the game to start with.
The version that is not chosen is kept in a backup, nothing is deleted.
Steam account in use on another device
Steam says a game is running on another device with this account. Steam only allows one game at a time per account. What to do for %1$s?
The game closes. Nothing is changed on the other device.
Close the other device\'s game and play here
Steam stops the game running on the other device. Whatever is not saved there is lost. %1$s then starts with its Steam ticket.
%1$s starts without a Steam ticket. A game that logs in to its own online services can fail or close. Play time is not counted on Steam. The other device is not touched.
The choice only applies to this launch.
